raw.rationale: DNQX is a quinoxalinedione AMPA/kainate receptor antagonist that is highly polar and unlikely to kill non-neuronal cancer cells selectively at 2.5 µM; PRISM screens of such glutamate receptor antagonists typically show no lineage-selective viability effects, with any apparent selectivity attributable to assay noise or general cytotoxicity. Thus probabilities are near the base rate for all lineages, with only a marginal increase for CNS/neuronal lineages where glutamate receptor expression is highest.
